images.empty: Nothing allowed — remote images stay blocked everywhere.
images.hint: Remote images in mail can be tracking pixels: loading them tells the sender whether and when a mail was opened.

images.modeAllowlistHint: Remote images load only after you allow them from the notice in the message.
images.modeAllowlistTitle: Remote images load only once you allow them in the message
images.title: Remote images

mobileSync.androidDescription: Satchel fetches new mail locally on this device. That needs the background service running and Android must not restrict the app.

mobileSync.tokenStorageNote: Removed from the form once handed over and stored in the protected {store}.

images.empty: Keine Freigaben — externe Bilder bleiben überall blockiert.
